entities.name: Surrakar
entities.description: Species of grey-skinned humanoid reptilians native to Zendikar that border on intelligence, ferocious and treasure-collecting.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: Subcontinent of Zendikar where surrakar thrive.

entities.name: Guum Wilds
entities.description: Region where surrakar marauders nest among boggy limestone hillocks.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Devastators of Bala Ged whose effect on the surrakar is unknown.

events.summary: The Eldrazi devastate Bala Ged; it is unknown whether the surrakar survived.
events.quote: It is unknown if the Surrakar have survived the Eldrazi devastation of Bala Ged.

relations.note: Surrakar thrive only on Bala Ged.
relations.quote: Surrakar are only known to thrive on the Bala Ged subcontinent

relations.note: Their fate under the Eldrazi devastation is unknown.
relations.quote: the Eldrazi devastation of Bala Ged
